svg.title: Kernel elapsed time trend: median milliseconds over recorded runs by scenario and runtime
svg.desc: Trend lines and points show median elapsed time in milliseconds across recorded runs from oldest (left) to newest (right). Lower means faster. Every panel uses an independent linear scale starting at zero. Failed or unavailable results have no point.

g.text: 20261023T162655.711802Z · 40 recorded runs · 3 samples per runtime and scenario
Lower points are faster · Linear axes start at zero · Oldest run on left, latest on right
